title: How an AI data center actually works (Vex explainer, Scribe; lighter persona with teasing lines)

voice.name: Mommy (generic Fish library voice; alternating with Dolly)

beats.say: This is where your chatbot answers come from. Let me show you around.
Every one of these racks holds seventy-two GPUs, and pulls about a hundred and thirty kilowatts. That's over a hundred homes. One rack.
The new campuses run a full gigawatt. That's about eight hundred thousand homes, on one campus.
And almost all of that power turns into heat. Liquid pipes carry it out to the cooling towers. So yes, your answer was literally warm.
All that compute, and your professor still wants it handwritten. Cute.
So Scribe writes it in my handwriting, graph and all. And if it looks too neat, hit Shuffle. It writes the whole page out another way.
One answer costs about a quarter of a watt-hour, and five drops of water.
